effective_tie_rule.interpretation: Methods within 0.01 absolute OOF Brier are treated as effectively tied for primary selection.

winner_rule: Choose lowest grouped-CV OOF Brier score.
If absolute Brier difference between leading methods is < 0.01, choose better AUROC for correctness discrimination.
rationale: No universal Brier-score practical-equivalence threshold exists. A 0.01 absolute margin is predeclared before correctness or calibration analysis to prevent post-hoc winner selection. Sensitivity thresholds are reporting-only.
